title: Support Process, Support, Intervention, Implementation, and Fidelity acceptance matrix

criteria.statement: Initial repository anchors are recorded.
Pre-ADR drift check is recorded.
Final pre-acceptance drift check is recorded.
Current Portia/Core contracts are reviewed.
Published schemas are not modified in place.
Support Process semantic unit is explicit.
Support, Intervention, Implementation, Fidelity, and Outcome are not collapsed.
#17 Response/Communication boundaries remain intact.
#19 Outcome/Follow-Up boundaries remain intact.
Teacher-local scope is explicit and does not claim IEP/504/BIP/FBA/clinical/institutional authority.
`support_process@1` is canonical and class-owned.
Existing `portia_support_process_id@1` is reused.
Canonical work path is defined.
One owning class is required.
Cross-class participation does not split ownership.
Support Process is not a student-global dossier.
participant identity/cardinality are explicit.
`support_process_target_ref@1` is operationally usable.
duplicate logical participants are invalid.
process workflow state is distinct from canonical lifecycle.
pause is distinct from invalidation.
completion is distinct from effectiveness/Outcome.
dates do not automatically change process state.
initiating context is explicit and exact where needed.
linked Events do not automatically establish pattern/cause/function.
Need semantics are explicit and non-diagnostic.
Need identity/cardinality/history decision is explicit.
Goal semantics are explicit.
Goal identity/cardinality/history decision is explicit.
Goals do not carry Outcome/effectiveness semantics.
no universal progress/compliance score is introduced.
Support vs. Intervention distinction is explicit.
separate-schema vs. discriminated-shared-schema decision is justified.
recipients/targets are explicit.
providers are explicit where applicable.
provider is distinct from recorder.
participant membership does not imply provider/recipient role.
provider identity does not establish authorization.
planned cadence/frequency is representable.
planned duration is representable.
`as_needed` or non-fixed cadence can be represented honestly.
planned dosage is distinct from actual implementation.
no authoritative mutable “times delivered” counter substitutes for Implementation records.
plan states exclude effectiveness/compliance labels.
material plan changes preserve history.
Implementation has durable opaque identity.
one Implementation represents one bounded occurrence/interval.
exact plan linkage is required.
actual provider is represented separately from recorder.
actual recipient/target is explicit.
occurrence chronology is validated.
neutral execution state is defined.
repeated occurrences remain separate records.
scheduled/reminder entries do not fabricate Implementation.
Communication does not fabricate Implementation.
Response handoff does not fabricate Implementation.
implementation-local variation is distinct from material plan adaptation.
Implementation does not contain effectiveness/Outcome.
one-off variation vs. material adaptation is defined.
whether `adaptation@1` is needed is explicitly decided.
material prospective plan change does not silently rewrite history.
correction and adaptation are not conflated.
successor topology is defined.
exact historical references never silently follow plan successors.
fidelity semantic unit is explicit.
evaluator is distinct from provider and recorder.
exact plan/Implementation scope is explicit.
basis/source is explicit.
unable-to-determine is representable.
instrument-defined numeric/scaled fidelity requires identified scale/version.
no universal fidelity score is invented.
fidelity is distinct from student compliance.
fidelity is distinct from provider competence.
fidelity is distinct from effectiveness and Outcome.
missing fidelity does not imply low fidelity.
high fidelity does not imply effectiveness.
implementation count does not imply fidelity.
Event-local `hypothesis@1` remains Event-local.
Support Process may reference exact Event hypotheses without automatic aggregation.
formal FBA is not fabricated.
whether a Support Process-local hypothesis is needed is explicitly decided.
no automatic Hypothesis → Intervention selection exists.
valid Support Process-owned Communication becomes current-use eligible through owner resolution.
Communication wire semantics are not broadened unnecessarily.
support coordination Communication remains distinct from Support/Implementation.
Determination/Response/Communication links use exact typed references.
several linked records do not become automatic evidence of success/need/cause.
lifecycle/reason vocabularies are defined for each new family where needed.
Amendment policy is explicit for each family.
Statement of Disagreement behavior is defined.
migration/removal compatibility is demonstrated.
operation/lock/Quarantine/Integrity Finding reuse is demonstrated.
derived state remains rebuildable and nonauthoritative.
derived state is privacy-minimized.
cross-year successor Support Process semantics are explicit.
predecessor/successor exact links are preserved.
cross-year continuation is distinct from migration and ownership correction.
old exact references do not silently retarget to the successor.
Core year closure does not automatically close/migrate a Support Process.
paper preallocation does not fabricate plan/Implementation/Fidelity.
import uncertainty can be represented honestly.
sensitive support narrative is minimized.
no diagnosis/eligibility/authorization is inferred.
no automatic intervention recommendation/escalation is introduced.
no automatic compliance/engagement/fidelity/effectiveness inference is introduced.
no automatic process completion from dates is introduced.
Core v0.6 `intervention_record_set` compatibility is considered.
#18 does not implement academic-result or Grade semantics.
#18 does not automatically publish intervention data.
future publication remains a privacy-minimized projection over Portia-native authority.
all required public Draft 2020-12 schemas are added.
schema catalog is updated.
valid fixtures are complete.
structural-invalid fixtures are complete.
application-invalid fixtures are complete.
cross-record/shared-infrastructure tests pass.
Support Process-owned Communication integration is tested.
existing schema-validation tests remain green.
full `tests/schema_validation` discovery passes.
`git diff --check` passes.
design document is complete.
ADR is accepted.
at least 40 synthetic examples are documented.
application-invalid matrix is complete.
acceptance matrix is complete.
final validation note is complete.
README/schema guide and related active documentation are reconciled.
no real student/family/staff/support data is committed.
